candidates.title: Multiple high-clearance sources say UAP is a real phenomenon
candidates.quote: One thing I've learned over the last year, I've heard from a whole bunch of people, totally separate sources with like very, very high security clearances, and I mean very high.

candidates.title: Multi-sensor corroboration of UAP (satellite, radar, visual, temperature)
candidates.quote: There's like evidence from satellite, uh you know, radar, visual sightings, temperature readings, it's all totally consistent.

candidates.title: Tyler Cowen's 2017 column on UFOs
candidates.quote: But I wrote a column about it in 2017 before it was like a thing.

candidates.title: Many UAP sightings off the coast of San Diego
candidates.place_text: Off the coast of San Diego, California
candidates.quote: And just where they are, like a lot are off the coast of San Diego.

candidates.title: Record number of UFO sightings in 2020
candidates.quote: These things are seen in in times of greater social breakdown. And so there's actually a record number of sightings in 2020.

candidates.title: Government getting ahead of service members ready to disclose
candidates.quote: And so many service people were on the verge of saying, "I can't not tell them what I saw."

candidates.title: Rumors of luring UAP with nuclear material traps
candidates.quote: There's rumors you hear, like are we setting traps for them? Are we trying to beckon them with with nuclear material and stuff?

candidates.title: Hereticon founder's startup to reverse engineer UFOs with quantum computing
candidates.quote: There's a founder here at Hereticon, who maybe is one of the most heretical thinkers here. He's trying to reverse engineer UFOs with, uh, quantum computing.
